name: 5-Bromo-DMT
summary: Psychedelic drug of the tryptamine class, and is also found in two marine invertebrates. Animal studies have shown that this could be useful for sedative and/or antidepressant use.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: 5-Bromo-DMT is a partial agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, with an affinity (Ki) of 138 nM, an EC50 of 77.7 to 3,090 nM, and an Emax of 34 to 100%. It also shows affinity for the serotonin 5-HT1A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors and for the serotonin transporter (SERT) (Ki = 16.9 nM, 403 nM, 193 nM, and 971 nM, respectively).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: It has been encountered as a novel designer drug.

summaryZh: 5-溴-N,N-二甲基色胺是一種迷幻藥和有機溴化合物，存在於海綿Smenospongia aurea和Smenospongia echina，也存在於Verongula rigida中。它是N,N-二甲基色胺的5-溴衍生物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. In animals it tends to cause sedation rather than psychedelic-type behaviour. Drugs of its class, the tryptamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, a faster heartbeat, anxiety and confusion.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。在動物身上，它傾向引起鎮靜而不是類迷幻的行為。與它同類的色胺類藥物可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、心跳加快、焦慮與意識混亂。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。在动物身上，它倾向引起镇静而不是类迷幻的行为。与它同类的色胺类药物可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、心跳加快、焦虑与意识混乱。

fact.en: It is one of the few psychedelic-type tryptamines found in the sea, made by marine invertebrates including some sponges, which build bromine straight into their molecules.
fact.zh: 它是少數在海洋中發現的迷幻類色胺之一，由包括某些海綿在內的海洋無脊椎動物製造；這些生物會直接把溴組進自己的分子裡。
fact.zhHans: 它是少数在海洋中发现的迷幻类色胺之一，由包括某些海绵在内的海洋无脊椎动物制造；这些生物会直接把溴组进自己的分子里。
